title: The Cookie Build play hub arrives on mobile
summary: The mobile app brings earned-coin kits, focused game stats and history, live linked-player status, and low-noise tools for finding players.
body:
- See your verified Minecraft username and current online status from Home and Profile.
- Review games played, wins, eliminations, a 30-day activity graph, and recent matches in a focused per-game Stats submenu.
- Unlock and select eligible MicroBattles and SkyWars kits with coins earned only through gameplay. There is no checkout or real-money purchase.
- Find players through exact usernames or recent shared matches, with privacy-scoped friend and party presence.
- Control player calls, selected-friend alerts, progression reminders, quiet hours, and online visibility without notification spam.
- Opening an event, news item, or player call from a notification now keeps the app navigation available and always provides a close action.
